sentence_stem: I can't come to the party tonight because
full_sentence: I can't come to the party tonight because I have to work late.
acceptable_variants: I have a lot of homework.
my sister needs help at home.

options.why_wrong: This expresses a feeling, not a reason, so it does not complete the cause started by 'because'.
This gives a fact about the party, not the reason the writer cannot come.
This is a closing remark, not a reason, and it does not explain why the writer cannot come tonight.

explanation: After 'because', we need a clause that gives the reason for the first part of the sentence. Learners often add a fact or a feeling instead of a reason, so check that the second part explains the first.
translation: Não posso ir à festa hoje à noite porque tenho que trabalhar até tarde.
